name: regression-tuple-contract
source:
import statistics
r=statistics.linear_regression([0,1,2],[1,3,5])
print(isinstance(r,tuple))
print(r == (2.0,1.0))
print(hash(r) == hash(tuple(r)))

name: regression-class-and-aliases
source:
import statistics
C=statistics.LinearRegression
x=[]
r=C(x,None)
print(type(r) is C,isinstance(r,C),r.slope is x,r.intercept is None)
print(C.__module__,r._fields is C._fields)
print(C._make([1,2]))
